cohort.aggregation: exact cds_sha256 groups, CAI constant within group

consistency_gate.on_failure: CONSISTENCY_GATE_FAILED_NOT_EVALUATED; stop scientific interpretation; engineering audit only
consistency_gate.reference: RK32 result_v2 vienna_local primary tests and seed_effects
consistency_gate.requirement: all four gate tests bitwise-equal within tolerance AND pass own Holm(4)

D1.implication: the natural RK33 truncated coverage still carries the increment within Kudla; coverage is NOT necessary; RK28/RK33 cross-study negatives cannot be attributed to coverage alone; host/assay/study-level factors become primary candidates; next step: cross-host full-coverage public data transport test; no further Kudla window mining

D2.condition: trunc_vs_simple fails AND exact_vs_trunc 4/4 AND gate passes
D2.implication: exact start-aware coverage beats the RK33 window and the RK33 window loses the increment within Kudla; start-aware coverage necessary within Kudla (natural-window evidence); clean upstream/start decomposition deferred to RK34; cross-host transport still unproven; host/assay not discriminated

D3.condition: gate passes AND trunc_vs_simple fails AND exact_vs_trunc fails
D3.implication: no claim of coverage necessity or sufficiency; includes small-effect/underpowered cases

reuse_gates: regenerated folds equal RK32 fold_assignments for all 10 seeds
RK32 null equals recomputed train target mean within 1e-12

models.histgb: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=squared_error, learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=200, max_leaf_nodes=7, min_samples_leaf=10, l2_regularization=1.0, early_stopping=False, random_state=seed+fold)

outer_evaluation.fold_scheme: whole-cluster balanced OOD, identical algorithm to RK32

power_note: 37 clusters with 20000 resamples detect large coverage effects of RK32 magnitude; effects below ~0.2 delta-Spearman may fall into D3; no post-hoc power adjustment; primary family reduced to 8 tests (vs an earlier 16-test sketch) to concentrate power on the transport question after RK34 took ownership of the matched-body decomposition

primary_inference.bootstrap: whole-cluster resample, int16 cluster indices, Spearman recomputed on concatenated resampled rows, MSE weighted by cluster multiplicity
primary_inference.multiplicity: Holm over the 8 primary tests only; gate family Holm(4) internal; secondary family Holm(12) descriptive only, no gate
primary_inference.pass_rule: effect>0 AND ci_lower>0 AND p_holm<0.05 AND positive_seeds>=8/10
primary_inference.permutation: within-cluster sign swap of the two arm predictions, int8 signs

relationship_to_RK34: RK34 (parallel session, matched N-mask factorial start_context) owns the clean upstream-vs-start decomposition with a fixed CDS4-38 body. RK35 is complementary: it tests the natural RK33 slice and natural CDS-start window, which RK34's N-masked controls cannot represent. RK35 secondary contrasts (atg_vs_trunc, exact_vs_atg) shift the CDS body and are therefore body-confounded; they are descriptive only and any clean decomposition is deferred to RK34.
scientific_question: Does the actual RK33 natural window CDS[3:45] (1-based CDS4-45, no start ATG, no upstream UTR) retain the RK32 local-structure increment within the frozen Kudla cohort, and does exact start-aware coverage beat it? Tests coverage-transport vs host/assay as explanations of the RK28/RK33 cross-study negatives, using natural (unmasked) windows.

window_definitions.cds_start_local: CDS[0:42], 42 nt, includes start ATG, no UTR, dangles=2, 37 C; energy from RK32 preflight local_cds42__dangles2
window_definitions.exact_local: UTR[-4:]+CDS[:38], 42 nt, dangles=2, 37 C; energy from RK32 preflight local_utr_minus4_cds38__dangles2
window_definitions.trunc_local: CDS[3:45] (1-based CDS4-45), 42 nt, excludes start ATG and UTR, dangles=2, 37 C; energy from RK35 preflight trunc_cds4_45__dangles2
window_definitions.trunc_local_d0: CDS[3:45], dangles=0, 37 C (RK33 prediction definition); secondary sensitivity only
